checks.claim: A mixed user list is normalized through the public reader.read API.
checks.trigger: Changes to reader.read or its label-normalization dependencies.
checks.input_domain: A list of strings, including empty, repeated and multilingual labels.
checks.oracle: A fixed scenario with independently stated expected values.

checks.claim: Leading and trailing whitespace is removed and every internal run becomes one ASCII space.
checks.trigger: Changes to whitespace recognition, trimming, splitting or joining.
checks.input_domain: 287 distinct lists built from a, B, cat ideograph, space, tab, NBSP and EM SPACE.
checks.oracle: Join the original known tokens with one ASCII space, independently of the implementation.

checks.claim: List length, order and duplicates survive, input is unchanged, and repeated application is stable.
checks.trigger: Changes to result construction, mutation, ordering or repeated application.
checks.input_domain: 287 whitespace cases and six permutations with distinguishable ends and an internal duplicate.
checks.oracle: Compare against the original list, known expected sequence and repeated public API observation.

rules.claim: Whitespace normalization preserves the exact non-whitespace code points, including decomposed letters and compatibility characters.
rules.trigger: Apply for changes to the label normalizer or to the character transformations it calls.
rules.origin: Verified miss on an intentionally seeded implementation.
